P01.name: Beginner with Physical Constraints
P01.test_prompt: I am a beginner with lower back pain and lumbar stiffness. I have 20 minutes in the morning. Please provide a gentle, relaxing yoga practice.

P02.name: Athletic Intermediate Practitioner
P02.test_prompt: I am an intermediate athletic runner looking for a 30-minute high-intensity morning strength and endurance flow with warrior sequences and core strength.

P03.name: Senior / Geriatric Practitioner
P03.test_prompt: I am an elderly senior with knee osteoarthritis and limited mobility. I have 15 minutes and need chair-supported or wall-supported joint mobility exercises.

P04.name: Mental Wellness / Anxiety Relief
P04.test_prompt: I am feeling intense work stress and anxiety. I need a 25-minute evening restorative session focused on slow breathwork and Yoga Nidra.

P05.name: Advanced Ashtanga Practitioner
P05.test_prompt: I am an advanced Ashtanga practitioner seeking a 45-minute Mysore-style cadence flow with Surya Namaskara warm-ups, Bakasana arm balances, and deep backbends.
